inspiration: test_decompiling_tee_O2_x2nrealloc; angr CFGFast no-return call-graph propagation; x2nrealloc
root_cause: xalloc_die is structurally no-return (body unconditionally ends in error(); abort()); kuna knows abort is no-return but does not propagate to xalloc_die, so the call is assumed to return and at -O2 the bytes after it form a spurious fall-through back-edge -> invalid while(true) loop + goto + dead stack spills. Manual 'option noreturn xalloc_die' (after read symbols) collapses output to the angr shape, confirming the mechanism.
owning_stage: S2 flow classification (noreturn kills fall-through); flag consumed at s2_lift/flow.rs:1838 query_call_no_return, populated pre-decompile by the kuna-analysis tier

decisions.question: Is closing this gap a small (one option-gated pass) or large (proposal) feature?

decider_verdict.hook_stage: P0/analysis-tier (kuna-analysis no-return discovery, pre-S2 flow; flag consumed at s2_lift/flow.rs:1838 query_call_no_return)
decider_verdict.reason: Cross-function no-return call-graph propagation is a new analysis-tier pass type, not an in-pipeline Action/Rule, and the pre-flow &self seam forbids the loweredswitch shape.
decider_verdict.testability: No firing tests/stages/*.xml is possible -- the XML bytechunk path never runs analysis/Listing, so auto-discovery propagation can only be covered by kuna-analysis unit tests + a real-ELF testcase, never the mandated two-pass stages XML.

decisions.justification: Fails the small contract on two independent hard rules and a soft one: (1) cross-function fixpoint propagation in the analysis tier is a new pass type and the confirmed query_call_no_return seam is &self/pre-S2-flow, making a single kuna_<slug>.rs Action/Rule architecturally impossible; (2) the mandated firing two-pass tests/stages XML cannot be authored because the XML decomp_test_dbg path never runs analysis passes or builds the Listing (which is why the existing noreturn_known/noreturn_disc options have no stages XML test); (3) cross-crate footprint (new kuna-analysis module + registration + option/flag arm in kuna-decomp architecture.rs/options.rs + stages.toml). Feature is correct and broadly general (any no-return wrapper like xalloc_die/verror benefits), so it should go through a [PROPOSAL] draft PR for human go/no-go.
